newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-MINING, QUARRYING AND MANUFACTURING SALES UP.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-MINING, QUARRYING AND MANUFACTURING SALES UP.

text.p: Sales in the mining, quarrying and manufacturing sectors of Lithuanian industry rose by six percent in March after falling by 11.5 percent in February, the country's statistics department said on Wednesday.
The biggest increase came in oil refining, which saw an increase of 76.2 percent in March, the department said in a statement.
Textile sales rose by 6.4 percent and manufacturing of chemical products rose by 8.7 percent.
Footwear product sales declined by 8.6 percent in March and leather processing sales fell by eight percent.
